A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LAOM study. All 21 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables and appendices, are readable and support reliable matching despite relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: V2 reports original DCS experiments, including policy returns, action-prediction errors, ablations, generalization tests and reconstruction analyses in Sections 4–5 and Appendix F.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results in Sections 4–5 and Appendix E, including comparisons of LAOM, LAOM+supervision, LAPO, BC and IDM.

M1.justification: LAOM's multistep IDM, unquantized latent actions, temporal-consistency objective, augmentations and action-supervision component are unchanged. V3's new pipeline diagram illustrates the existing procedure rather than introducing a method change.

E1.justification: Both versions use cheetah-run, walker-run, hopper-hop and humanoid-walk, with the same distracting and distractor-free conditions. Unseen-background evaluation and leave-one-environment-out cross-embodiment transfer are retained without additional coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: main comparisons retain LAPO, BC and IDM, while cross-embodiment comparisons retain LAPO and BC without IDM. The newly cited IGOR work is not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Both retain 5,000 training trajectories and 50 evaluation trajectories per task, 2–128 labeled-trajectory budgets, 25-episode evaluations, linear-probe MSE and BC-normalized returns. Preprocessing, training settings, parameter counts and hyperparameters in Tables 5–10 are unchanged.

E4.justification: Quantization and component ablations, latent-dimensionality sensitivity, unseen-distractor generalization, cross-embodiment transfer and reconstruction analyses are unchanged. Their figures are retained across renumbering, and the appendices introduce no additional analysis.

E5.justification: Both report averaging over three random seeds and retain identical plotted uncertainty bands. No run-count disclosure, uncertainty-reporting practice or statistical test is added or revised.

E6.justification: Both report the same 0.44 aggregate normalized return and probe-MSE ablation values, including 22.09 and 2.74 in v2 Figure 5/v3 Figure 6. Table 3's normalization returns and all matched main-text and appendix result graphics are unchanged; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Section 2's mathematical definitions, inverse/forward dynamics formulation and discussion of control-endogenous minimal states are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs relative to the other.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about LAPO's difficulty with distractors, LAOM's eightfold improvement in latent-action quality and the benefit of supervision using 2.5% of action labels. The shortened Section 5 heading does not substantively change these claims.

C2.justification: Mechanistic explanations and applicability qualifications are unchanged. V2 Appendix A's limitations concerning simulation-to-web generalization, label availability, cross-embodiment transfer and hyperparameter tuning move to v3 Section 7 without substantive edits.

D1.justification: V2 Appendix D promises post-review release of code, configurations and Weights & Biases logs. V3 Appendix C instead states that code is open source and provides a repository link, dropping the explicit configuration/log-release promise. Implementation details, hardware and training times remain unchanged; repository contents are not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: V3 adds Chen et al. (2024a), IGOR, to the introduction, related-work discussion and bibliography. The existing MOTO reference becomes Chen et al. (2024b). This is a limited citation expansion; the broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: V3 moves limitations from Appendix A into Section 7 before the conclusion, shortens the Section 5 heading and adds an explanatory pipeline caption. Small wording edits and conference front-matter updates accompany the reorganization; most prose is unchanged.

P2.justification: V3 adds the pipeline overview as Figure 3, relocates the environment and architecture illustrations, and enlarges several existing figures, especially the reconstruction examples. Captions and table placement adjust with the reflow, while existing graphic content and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The new pipeline overview, enlarged reconstruction examples and placement of limitations before the conclusion modestly improve clarity and accessibility. The repository pointer and IGOR citation improve documentation, although the PDFs do not establish availability of accompanying configurations or logs. These are limited gains; the methods and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
